comment: The statement that standard components ‘arrive tested’ overstates what standards and shared test artifacts can guarantee. A product may pass a conformance suite while its configuration, deployment, security, performance, accessibility, data quality and fit with local work remain untested. This could encourage procurement teams to equate certification with implementation readiness.

public.text: The statement that standard components ‘arrive tested’ overstates what standards and shared test artifacts can guarantee. A product may pass a conformance suite while its configuration, deployment, security, performance, accessibility, data quality and fit with local work remain untested. This could encourage procurement teams to equate certification with implementation readiness.
public.suggestedRevision: Say that reusable specifications and test suites reduce—but do not replace—local verification. Require product conformance testing plus configuration, integration, security/privacy, performance, usability/accessibility, workflow, data-quality, failover and user-acceptance testing in the intended setting.
